messages:
elaine: Hey team — TidalHealth just sent their RFI bundle. Main asks: capability matrix, POC schedule, SAML/KMS answers, and an itemized pilot cost. Can we assemble attachments by EOD tomorrow?
elaine: Key bit — they want an explicit fallback plan if Dedicated capacity spikes >80% during POC.
omar: I can take the capability matrix and the model compatibility table. Will map our hosted/dedicated/private columns. ETA EOD today.
matt: I’ll own the POC runbook and the sample config for their infra (VPC peering + SSO notes). Need the expected QPS and avg tokens from them — asked for numbers in a follow-up.
liz: Security questionnaire — I need to confirm HSM/bring-your-own-KMS options and our data retention policy for POC logs. Security-bot, do we have the canned answers for SOC2 + KMS key escrow?
security-bot: Automated response: SOC2 Type II statement dated 2025-06-12 (link: https://internal.redwood/docs/soc2). KMS: BYOK supported for Private deployments; Dedicated uses customer-managed keys via KMS integration.
omar: Adding a short feature row for "automatic KV caching" and "prefix caching" — important for their latency SLOs. Also will include quant profiles we recommend for throughput.
elaine: Pricing question from procurement: can we split pilot cost into base + overage? They prefer monthly commitment + burst billing. We have standard Dedicated trial tiers but can do a custom pilot quote. Matt, can you draft a sample pricing table?
matt: Drafting now. Proposal: $12k/mo reserved for 4 vGPUs baseline (pilot tier), $0.08/1000 tokens overage, and optional support add-on. Will share CSV.
liz: For the security doc answers, we need to be explicit on data residency — TidalHealth requires EU-only processing for patient PII. Can we confirm region pinning for models?
omar: Yes — Hosted supports region pinning for EU (eu-west-1), Private obviously customer-controlled. Noting in matrix: "region pinning: hosted (eu): yes, dedicated: yes with configuration, private: yes"
elaine: Awesome. Can we also attach a short recorded demo of the console showing rollout & tracing? They asked for operational observability proof. Matt can you capture 2 min clip and link it in attachments.
matt: Uploaded a 2:12 mp4 to Drive: https://drive.redwood/tidal-poc-demo.mp4
omar: Capability matrix attached (internal link): https://drive.redwood/tidal-cap-matrix.xlsx — includes model compatibility, quantization support, latency/throughput rows, and fallbacks.
liz: Security answers draft attached: https://drive.redwood/tidal-security-answers.docx — includes KMS, SAML SSO, audit log retention (90d by default, extendable), and incident response contact.
elaine: Great — I’ll compile final RFI package: matrix + pricing CSV + security doc + POC runbook + demo link. Sending to TidalHealth legal for review after internal sign-off.
elaine: Quick ask — Omar, can you add a short note in the matrix about expected per-request latency under the quant profile? They care about 95th percentile under 256 token responses.
omar: Will do. Adding a sample measurement: 95p = 180ms on p4d with 8-batch continuous batching (see comments).
elaine: Perfect. If we can get everything in before 17:00 UTC tomorrow, I’ll push to procurement. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Reminder: attach redacted logs only. Do not include customer PII in attachments.
liz: Noted — redacting screenshots and logs.
elaine: Thanks everyone — will post final zip here once ready.
